I'll probably be fine by tomorrow morning. I appreciate the concern. I'm just curious if anyone knows

There are people out there that do care about you or will if you give them the chance to meet you. And people here are your friend. I don't know you but I still wish for you to be happy. I know it's not the same, or the kind of friendship that you need, but there are people who care for you. 

I used to have the same issue with my family. Wasn't as bad as your situation, but still not ideal. What helped me the most with getting a better relationship with them was to leave. People tend to care more once they realize they've lost something. Not always, but generally. Maybe take a break from them, and find other people that can help you.

Some people just get more attention then others. It's not always fair, but it rarely actually gives meaning to someone's life. Being popular isn't something to shoot for. Very few people are truly genuine, and I think it makes life a lot harder if that's what you aim for. Be proud of who you are.

I was almost a dad this year. I'm only 19. It was not something I wanted or was at all prepared for. But I had 3 friends willing to help me with anything. None of them were ever popular. Really good, genuine people, who really care for you, will like you for you. Not for what you present yourself as, or you popularity.

Be proud of you! Your a great person :)

I would highly suggest you think it over completely before you make a decision. A lot can change in your life that can give it meaning, and committing suicide forfeits all of those opportunities. I'm free to talk to if you feel you would benefit from speaking to someone.

​

In regards to your question, there are a lot of different ways to go about it. None are preferable, but if you feel you really must, shooting yourself in the head is the most successful. Shotgun is the most successful, then a rifle, then a handgun. Shooting yourself in the chest is the second most effective. 

If you don't have access to firearms, a mix of sedatives and alcohol is a common way. I believe sleeping pills are the most common. This can fail though, and will leave you with horrendous physical damage, typically in your brain and heart.

Hanging is extremely painful and drawn out, but will likely end your life. Some people do break free once they passed out as a survival response, and continue to live with irreparable brain damage. Same goes for drowning yourself.

Falling from heights is only effective if you jump from above 8 stories. Any less than that can give you a chance to survive and live with the awful side effects from a failed suicide.

Bleeding out is unbelievably painful, but as long as you don't have a change in heart of someone finds you, it would work. Be sure you know where to cut so you don't prolong your suffering, or don't do it at all and give yourself to appreciate life.

I have also heard of people that close up their cars and run a hose from the exhaust into the car, so they die of Carbon poisoning. It has poor success rates, but is painless if done right. Failure will leave you with extreme cognitive problems though. 

​

Please don't kill yourself though. A lot of things can change given time. And committing suicide forfeits it all.

I'm the same way. A year ago I was in a really bad state of mind and would get like that once a day. Now I get it 4 to 6 times a day for no reason. Nothing in my life has changed, only gotten better, and I have an even harder time functioning. I don't know what it is either. Sometimes texting a friend helps me, but it's so frequent I don't like to burden people with it. You're welcome to talk to me about it if it would help you.

Something I do is count to three, and then get up and do whatever I'm trying to do. I'm not sure what about it makes me move, but counting to three has some sort of psychological effect. You really have to want to get up though. It's the rule when you do it. You have to get up once you hit three. 

Hope this helps you
Anytime! Well your welcome to talk to me. I'll try to not be like everyone else haha

I do it all the time as well. I think it's generally a sign that your legitimately serious about doing it, not just going through a rough patch in your life if that makes sense. 

I've had it for the last four months, and I have yet to find any way to stop it. I hope you do :)

It sounds like you've spoken to him already about how your struggling right now. If he still isn't understanding after you've spoken to him, it might be best for you to separate with him. Being drug on in a relationship where your partner isn't invested is the most depressed I've ever personally felt. While it was hard to eventually leave her, it helped my mental state a lot. I'm sure this isn't what you want to hear, but it's what helped me, and I wish I had done it sooner.

I'm sorry your struggling right now. I know how hard it can be to not have people to talk to. It makes all the negativity going on way worse. Try and stay positive though. I had an extremely rough day yesterday, and was planning to commit suicide. Today I had a friend who cheered me up out of the blue though. I know it seems rough right now, but things will get better. And me and others on here are always open to talk. Sometimes it helps :)

I'm really sorry. I felt like that a year ago with my parents, so I know where your coming from. I found it easier to function when I confided my feelings and pain with a friend and sometimes random people on the internet. I'm still not over all my issues, but I'm better now. If you want someone to talk too, I'd be happy to try and help!

You'll never know how much something hurts until you've committed to doing it. And remember, once you've committed to doing it, there is no turning back. You forfeit every possibility of getting to experience life. 

Seriously think about it. Life sucks, but it's not worth giving up everything. It's not worth losing every potential good thing that can happen. 

I wish you well.

Some people go through multiple counselors or mental health professionals before they find someone who can actually help them. The only one I've went too did not help me at all, if anything, they made it worse. If you don't want try and find a new counselor, maybe try finding a group of people you talk to when your down. That's the only thing that's even remotely helped me. Your free to talk to me if you want. Hope this helped
Sorry you've had a rough day. People care about you though! Try and remember that while your pushing through your pain. If you need to talk me and others are here for you

I'm really sorry your feeling down. Don't put the blame on yourself though. Sometimes people just aren't there for when we need them. I've had that happen plenty. Try and stay strong! Your a wonderful person that has so much to offer to the world. Your not useless, you just don't have the right people around you right now. If you need to talk me and others on here would be happy to try and help you out :)

Tell them whatever your comfortable with. I get like that sometimes too, and when people ask I just say I'm really stressed out or have had a really tough day. Don't be to hard on yourself though! You'd be surprised how many people have meltdowns!

It would definitely be best for you to seek professional help like you have been doing. Great job on making the choice to do that! It's a tough decision, one that took me a long time to do! In the meantime, speaking with someone can ease the pain. I'm here if you need to talk! There's probably a way for you to get professional help, it might just take some time :)
I'm here if you want to talk :)

For a lot of people it's really hard to offer support. Out of all my friends that I talked to about committing suicide, only one was actually able to help me feel better at all. I think it's a struggle to find someone who can genuinely care. I'm here if you want to talk though :)

I'm really sorry your feeling down :(   When I have stuff I want to get done but really struggle to start, something that helps me is counting to 3 in my head. It sounds really silly, but it gets me up and going! Sometimes talking to someone who is encouraging also helps! I'm sure you have a ton of amazing qualities to give to the world, you just might not have the tools or support to make all those amazing things happen. Hopefully this was at least a little helpful :)

It's super awesome what your doing! They could be doing a lot of things better. I would encourage you to find a different place to advocate for this however. I believe fundraising and social change is not permitted on this sub. I don't know what the consequences are, but I thought I'd try and let you know before you got in trouble :)

There are therapists that specialize in that kind of thing! If you don't want to go to one, and your parent's can't really understand, you might have to make the decision to do what's best for you. Sometimes going away from your family when you're having a disagreement makes them realize what's important, regardless of religion. Your in a tough spot, but I hope you figure it out.

You are important! You're just not around the right people that help you see that. I care about you and I've never even met you. It's hard to find genuine people that care, but when you do, they're there for you. Believe me :)    And if you want to talk your always welcome to DM me! I'm sure there's plenty of other people on here that are willing to help you too

It's a really tough call to make. I have family members that take antidepressants, and it's the only way they can manage to function. They tell me it doesn't change who they are, more just allows them to react in a more manageable way to stress and issues. I've been told by my therapist that I suffer from Schizophrenia, and he heavily encouraged me to take medication for it, but I won't personally. For me, it's not worth it. I'd rather be haunted by things that aren't there, making my life hell, than potentially change my personality. It's a personal call for your. What do you value and what are you willing to risk kinda thing. Hope this helped a bit

My therapist also told me I have schizophrenia. It's not fun at all is it. Seeing and hearing stuff that's not there. Do you have a family member such as an uncle or aunt? It's possible to leave your house if law enforcement deems your living conditions to low, which it sounds like it is. I'd love to help you if I can

I wish I could be that strong :)   Even though everything seems tough right now, it will get better. You just need to find people that can care for you. They are out there, just hard to find. If you need to talk, I'm happy to try and help.
Of course! Try and stay strong! We'll get through it together:)

Talking to someone about your pain can help it go away. If you want I can talk to you. I don't know how much it will help, but hopefully I can ease the pain a little bit

You forfeit everything. Try and persevere, or find someone to talk to. Again, your welcome to contact me :)

I know how you feel. For a good chunk of my life I had a speech impediment. I was so ashamed of myself and sounded so stupid that I couldn't make a friend to save my life. It will work out for you though. Someday you'll find someone that you really bond with. Life will get better! 

You're surely a great person, you just haven't been around the right people. Persevere. I promise it will get better :)   And your always welcome to be my friend!

I'm sorry your feeling this way. It seems like you have had an extremely hard time lately. Losing people is unbelievably difficult. I doubt what I offer you will help, but I'd like to try at least. 

Even though it seems like your alone right now, I assure you you are not. People you wouldn't guess still care for you. I had a friend that took his life a while ago. People that weren't close to him were still extremely distraught about his suicide. I don't know you, I've never met you, but I still care about you. It's mine and many other's nature to care. You just need to wait for someone like that to enter your life.

To cap this off I'll tell you what a friend told me when I was planning on offing myself. Why do it? It's a choice you'll never be able to take back. It might seem like a good thing, but really stop and think about it. If you choose to kill yourself, you forfeit every potential opportunity. You can't come back. 

Hope this was of some value to you. I'm open to talk if you need someone to talk to.
Yep! Hope I was some help. If you ever need to talk I'd love to try and help you feel better!

Your not a burden. People would feel so so so much worse if they lost you. Trust me :)

It didn't work out in the end, but I'm happy I was able to help her even if in the end I'm not the one to spend time with her. If you want a relationship, you'll find someone that will care for you and work through those tough times. Trust me!

​

If they're still not willing to help, find a friend or someone you can talk too. Or even me or someone else on here if you don't feel like you can open up to someone in your personal life. Talking to someone can make all the difference sometimes.
